name: imposter-holochain
description: Imposter on Holochain — hidden roles + tamper-evident voting on a per-lobby DNA, real-time movement over PeerKit.

scripts.build:zomes: sh scripts/in-nix.sh cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p game_integrity -p game
scripts.build:happ: sh scripts/in-nix.sh sh -c 'npm run build:zomes && hc dna pack dnas/game/workdir && hc app pack workdir'
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:round
scripts.spin: sh scripts/in-nix.sh env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11 hc-spin -n 4 --ui-port 5173 workdir/imposter.happ
